title: 1950201-PLP-001
summary:
- The document is a Penetrant Liquids Procedure for Arizona Solar One's HEX replacement TES Solana project.
- It outlines the purpose, scope, and responsibilities of personnel involved in the procedure.
- The procedure requires qualified personnel to perform evaluations and interpretations.
- Codes from ASME and other standards are referenced for compliance.

- The procedure involves using liquid penetrant for detecting mechanical discontinuities in materials.
- Products used include ARDROX and MAGNAFLUX penetrants, removers, and developers.
- Cleaning must be thorough to remove contaminants before applying the penetrant.
- Temperature control is crucial during the examination process.
- Penetrant dwell time varies based on temperature and should not exceed 30 minutes.
- Excess penetrant removal requires organic solvent application followed by drying.
- Developer application should be done as soon as possible after removing excess penetrant.
summary_points: The document is a Penetrant Liquids Procedure for Arizona Solar One's HEX replacement TES Solana project.
It outlines the purpose, scope, and responsibilities of personnel involved in the procedure.
The procedure requires qualified personnel to perform evaluations and interpretations.
Codes from ASME and other standards are referenced for compliance.
The document is owned by Abengoa and cannot be reproduced or distributed without permission.
The procedure involves using liquid penetrant for detecting mechanical discontinuities in materials.
Products used include ARDROX and MAGNAFLUX penetrants, removers, and developers.
Cleaning must be thorough to remove contaminants before applying the penetrant.
Temperature control is crucial during the examination process.
Penetrant dwell time varies based on temperature and should not exceed 30 minutes.
Excess penetrant removal requires organic solvent application followed by drying.
Developer application should be done as soon as possible after removing excess penetrant.
Interpretation of results begins once the developer is dry, with a minimum of 10 minutes.
Post-cleaning is necessary if residual products could interfere with subsequent processing.
Final evaluation of indications should be done after development time and before delay.
Accept/reject criteria include cracks, linear and rounded indications.
Final report must include job number, procedure details, drawing, and more.
Table 2 outlines requirements for liquid penetrant examination procedures.
El procedimiento requiere recualificación si hay cambios en los requerimientos de la Tabla 2.
Se utilizan productos específicos para líquidos penetrantes y deben ser compatibles con el material a examinar.
La limpieza debe realizarse con un disolvente específico según el producto utilizado.
El tiempo de permanencia del penetrante varía según la temperatura, pero no debe exceder los 30 minutos recomendados por el fabricante.
Se deben eliminar completamente los restos de penetrante antes de aplicar el revelador.
La superficie debe estar completamente seca antes de aplicar el revelador y durante todo el proceso de interpretación.
El procedimiento incluye la aplicación del penetrante, revelador y evaluación de indicaciones.
Se requiere limpieza final para eliminar productos no deseados.
Las indicaciones se evalúan según criterios específicos de tamaño y forma.
Los informes finales deben documentar detalles técnicos y resultados de la inspección.
